comparator.route: Chemistry of Life specialisation with University Minor
comparator.sourceNotes: The formally adopted 2026–2027 Chemistry regulations account for the full 180 EC. Year 1 is twelve compulsory 5-EC courses. The remaining 120 EC comprise ten further compulsory 5-EC chemistry courses, one 20-EC specialization, a 5-EC Research Practical, a 15-EC Bachelor Research Project and a 30-EC minor. The generic target offers Chemistry of Life, Smart Materials, and Sustainable Chemistry and Energy. No option is clearly more general, so Chemistry of Life is selected by the formal regulations’ official-order tie-break, independently of UCR fit. The genuine 30-EC University Minor remains open choice space. The live programme page and formally adopted 2026–2027 Chemistry regulations were rechecked on 2026-10-14; the settled specialization, open minor and 180-EC reconstruction remain unchanged.

alternativeSelection.assessment: The molecular, cellular and biomedical programme is the strongest complete related-fields response to the selected Chemistry of Life route and its molecular, medicinal, laboratory and quantitative interests. Materials, sustainable energy and environmental applications support a substantially distinct second route through biochemistry, Earth materials, geochemistry, circularity, resources and quantitative science; the two routes differ by fifteen courses (112.5 EC) each. The next direction, synthetic, inorganic and physical chemistry, fails because UCR lacks the required cumulative chemistry, synthesis, spectroscopy, chemical-analysis and specialist laboratory sequence. Production stops at two.

comparisonAlignment.rationale: Both address molecules and their functions; UCR introduces biomolecules inside life science rather than teaching general molecular structure and reactivity.
Both directly study biomolecules, metabolism and biochemical mechanisms; UCR does so within life science rather than a chemistry sequence.
Molecular Cell Biology directly studies cellular molecules, gene expression and signalling, while not reproducing the comparator’s chemistry framing.

The UCR laboratory includes bacterial techniques, protein production, DNA analysis and bioinformatics, directly overlapping recombinant-DNA and biotechnology practice while remaining one broad life-science laboratory.
Pharmacology directly studies molecular drug targets, therapeutic action and toxicity, addressing an applied part of chemical biology without reproducing its chemistry foundation.
Both address bioenergy; UCR analyses renewable-system design and performance rather than metabolism and bioresource chemistry.
Both provide mathematical foundations for scientific study; UCR is a broad methods course rather than chemistry-specific mathematics.
Advanced Calculus directly develops multivariable calculus and differential equations, while the comparator component also integrates linear algebra for chemistry.

notes.text: Groningen Chemistry requires cumulative general, organic, inorganic, physical and quantum chemistry, spectroscopy, transport phenomena, materials, synthesis and analysis laboratories, specialist chemistry study and an experimental research project. UCR can combine molecular and biomedical life science with quantitative methods, or pursue biochemistry, environmental materials and sustainable resource systems. These are coherent related-fields responses rather than reproductions of the Chemistry curriculum.

The external programme has a fixed chemistry and laboratory core, a 20-EC specialisation, a research practical, a 15-EC chemistry research project and a genuine 30-EC minor. UCR assembles adjacent sciences across individually selected 7.5-EC courses and offers no scheduled specialist chemistry thesis or staged chemistry laboratory sequence.
